facts.support_excerpt: Named opposite mechanisms: euro-area inflation firming ECB hike pricing low risk beta (EURUSD barely fell on 5 Nov).
facts.text: **EUR/USD.** The review names firmer euro-area inflation, expectations of ECB rate increases and limited sensitivity to broader risk moves as counterweights to the dollar bid. It also notes that EUR/USD barely fell on 5 November.

facts.support_excerpt: The Asia USD bid may be pre-NFP positioning that unwinds on the print rather than a durable USD trend; gold's Asia drop with rising equities looks like a haven unwind
facts.text: The useful distinction is between a common backdrop and market-specific evidence. The review's dollar-positioning explanation can be challenged by the payrolls reaction; it does not resolve each market's countercase in advance.

title: Capital Chronicle's pre-payrolls review: a dollar bid with different countercases
